decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a cheap consumable in the core thermoforming range, but they have not been visible online since 2018, which suggests lower priority.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a staple dental lab material that supports recurring consumable sales, even though it has had little recent web visibility.
The UV-curing lacquer only ever had a website mention and has not been seen since, which makes it the weakest candidate, but it is cheap to keep and fits finishing workflows.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's strategic shift toward digital scanning workflows, which justifies keeping it despite low recent visibility.
Custom earmolds are core custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers and are more likely to be refined into successor models than discontinued outright.
